# healthchecksio_status (Data Source)

The status of the server. Use it in a precondition for a self-hosted server. If the server does not answer, the read fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "healthchecksio_status" "server" {}

resource "healthchecksio_check" "backup" {
  name = "Nightly backup"

  lifecycle {
    precondition {
      condition     = data.healthchecksio_status.server.ok
      error_message = "The healthchecks server cannot query its database."
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ok` (Boolean) True when the server can query its database. False when the server answers with a 5xx status.
